events.name: Jurassic Quest – Memphis, TN | AgriCenter International Expo
events.description:
The Ultimate Family Adventure!
Jurassic Quest — the world’s most popular dinosaur experience — is now the ultimate event for LEGO®  brick builders and fans.  Get ready for the ULTIMATE day of discovery, play, and imagination!
Dino Fans: Step into the age of dinosaurs and marvel at life-size, moving giants — including the towering Apatosaurus, colossal Spinosaurus, and legendary T. rex. Enjoy hands-on fossil digs, meet adorable baby dinos, and hop on thrilling dino rides.
Brick Fans: Unleash your imagination with massive LEGO-inspired sculptures, build your own designs, explore interactive play zones, and race your custom build in the wildly popular Brick Derby!
One weekend only and one ticket gets it all — grab your tickets now before they’re gone!

events.name: Collage Dance Collective: RISE
events.info: Every generation builds upon the one before it. The artists, dreamers, and visionaries who came before us continue to shape the stories we tell, the stages we share, and the future we imagine. RISE celebrates that enduring legacy through four remarkable works by some of ballet's most influential voices. Featuring Darrell Grand Moultrie's Lineage, George Balanchine's Valse Fantaisie, Kevin Thomas' Rise, and a world premiere by Donald Byrd inspired by the Harlem Renaissance, the program explores the power of artistic inheritance, resilience, and renewal. From timeless masterworks to bold new creation, RISE is a celebration of the artists whose courage continues to redefine ballet and the generations who will carry it forward.
